reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the finding correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, consistent with the rule's instruction not to redline where the MFN does not burden Customer.
Party mapping is correct: Sanofi is the licensee/paying party (our side), RevMed the licensor/counterparty.

Cited paragraphs support the conclusion: Section 9.3(a) sets fixed tiered royalty rates and 9.3(c)(iii) a Third Party Right offset with a Royalty Floor — neither obliges Sanofi to extend RevMed any better terms granted to a third party or to match a third-party offer.

The only third-party-comparison mechanic identified (Section 3.5(b) SHP1-SHP2 Dual Inhibitor right of first negotiation) runs in Sanofi's favour, which the rule expressly treats as welcome, so marking compliant rather than flagging is correct.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped; no deterministic check failures and no unnecessary edits.
